description:
Situated 1km from the Kicking Horse Resort, Dawn Mountain Nordic Trail found within the Dawn Mountain Recreation site (REC5069) offers 33 km of expertly groomed trails for classic and skate skiing and a 4km snowshoe loop, all of which is maintained in partnership with Golden Nordic Ski Club Society (GNSCS). The trail network offers stunning views of the Purcell Mountains and across the valley to the Rockies.

A variety of terrain suits all abilities of trail users, including seasoned Nordic skiers and first timers on the trail.

Within its License of Occupation, GNSCS offers a cozy Chalet with seating, a kitchen available for use, and indoor toilets.
The trailside warming shelter, Owl's Roost, is jointly maintained in partnership with the Metis Nation Columbia River Society and the GNSCS.

Trail fees apply during the winter months of November 1st to April 30th, please pay your trail fee and sign in at Dawn Mountain Chalet before heading out to the trails.

For information on other activities, up-to-date trail fees and trail conditions, please visit Golden Nordic Ski Club website at
directions:
Follow signs from Golden to Kicking Horse Mountain Resort, 13 km from town. During the week the road may be barred by an unlocked gate. Skiers may go through but are asked to close the gate behind them, when coming to or going from the ski area. The Nordic Trails are located at the base of the ski area adjacent to the parking lot.
